# Orkas **An open-source team of AI agents on your desktop — it turns your goals into finished work and keeps it moving.** Orkas is an open-source (MIT), local-first multi-agent desktop app — an AI assistant that works as a team. Tell the **Commander** what you need: it finishes many tasks on its own, and for bigger work it plans the steps and brings in specialist agents along with the coding and personal agents you already use — **Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes-Agent** — to work on it together. Orkas is built to keep a project moving, not just answer one prompt. A **project** holds the goal, rules, memory and files, so every new conversation picks up where the last one left off. **To-dos** split the work between people and agents, **Auto-advance** lets the team take on the next to-do by itself, and **scheduled automations** repeat routine work hourly, daily, weekly or monthly. All your data stays on your computer, and finished work comes back for your review — so you can trust Orkas with the ongoing work of your business. **[⬇ Download Orkas for macOS & Windows](https://orkas.ai/download/?source=gh-orkas&entry_point=github_readme&download=1)** — free, with 500 credits for the built-in Orkas model, so you don't need an API key to start. Prefer your own keys? Claude · OpenAI · Gemini · DeepSeek · Kimi · GLM · Qwen · MiniMax · Doubao, or a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint. ### Recreate a reference video with your own content **VideoStudio** can recreate a viral video's narrative structure, visual style and editing pace using your own product, script and footage. Supply a reference video file and your assets: the agent analyzes the hook, information order, visual beats and call to action, then proposes what to preserve and what to replace before production. This works best for motion-graphic explainers, SaaS or app demos, and product ads built from your existing footage. Locally authored text, captions, narration and clips can be revised separately; text baked into AI-generated footage requires changing that footage. > "Use reference.mp4 as a reference for a 30-second vertical promo. Keep its hook, typography and pacing, replace the content with my product and screen recordings, and show me the breakdown and plan first." Start with a video file the agent can read; social-platform share-link downloading is not built in. Exact camera moves, human performances and frame-by-frame matching are not guaranteed. See the [reference-recreation workflow](./resources/builtin/marketplace/agents/79df9cc89f5f/skills/video-craft/references/reference-recreation.md). --- ## Keep the work moving One task is a good start. See [Download](#download) above. To run from source — currently the way to run Orkas on Linux: **Requirements**: Node 22.12+ · macOS / Windows 10+ / glibc 2.34+ Linux x64 or arm64. Keep Python 3 and a C/C++ build toolchain available for the uncommon native-module source-build fallback. ```bash git clone https://github.com/Orkas-AI/Orkas.git cd Orkas ./run.sh # macOS / Linux run.cmd # Windows ``` Linux source runs require glibc 2.34+. Alpine and other musl-based distributions are not supported. Local speech transcription downloads and verifies the target-native whisper.cpp runtime and multilingual model during the first source launch. `run.sh` / `run.cmd` installs the locked npm dependency tree and prepares the pinned Python, uv, Node, embedding model (~95 MB), OfficeCLI, FFmpeg, whisper.cpp, and multilingual speech model resources on first launch. Linux startup then verifies the platform-native modules and Whisper runtime under Electron's ABI before opening the app. OCR and Skill-specific Python packages are installed into isolated local environments when those features are first used. First launch creates a workspace under `~/.orkas/` (macOS / Linux) or `:\.orkas\` (Windows). Then open **Settings → AI Providers** to add an API key or OAuth. Native dependency errors: use Node.js 24 LTS (minimum 22.12.0), then run `npm run native:repair` from this checkout. This restores optional packages, repairs SQLite for Electron, prepares bundled Node for isolated image processing, and checks SQL, sqlite-vec and sharp before success. Use `npm run native:check` for a check without installation. See the [native dependency verification script](./scripts/verify-native-dependencies.cjs) for the checks performed. --- ## How it works ### Task routing The Commander handles general work itself and delegates specialist work through three tools: - **`dispatch_to`** runs a named agent and returns its result for continued work. It can wait for the result or run asynchronously and notify the Commander when the task finishes. - **`hand_off_to`** transfers the remaining work to a named agent and ends the current Commander turn. The agent delivers its own reply; an optional continuation lets the Commander resume a broader task afterward. - **`run_worker`** runs an anonymous, isolated sub-task and returns a private result. It does not receive conversation history or a named agent's skills. Named agent tasks and anonymous workers have separate concurrency controls. See the [dispatch implementation](./src/main/features/group_chat/bus.ts) and [execution locks](./src/main/util/locks.ts). ### Context management The runtime budgets context against the selected model's usable input capacity, accounting for prompts, tools and persistent runtime state. Completed dialogue uses a bounded recent-history window; long active tasks use checkpoints to condense earlier process messages while retaining recent work. File reads, file changes and command executions also have structured records that can survive context compaction. See [context budgets](./src/core-agent/src/agent/context-budget.ts), [session history and checkpoints](./src/core-agent/src/agent/session.ts) and [workspace records](./src/core-agent/src/agent/workspace-state.ts). ### Memory and the Library Durable notes keep user preferences, project facts and each agent's reusable knowledge in separate scopes. These notes are distinct from the Library's document index and the stored conversation history. The Library extracts documents into passages and stores a local SQLite vector index. Its embedding model runs on your machine; the `library` tool can list files, search relevant passages and read source content from the global or current-project Library. Earlier conversations are retrieved separately through `chat_history`. See [scoped memory](./src/main/features/memory.ts), [document extraction](./src/main/util/file_to_chunks.ts), [Library tools](./src/main/model/core-agent/kb-tools.ts) and [conversation retrieval](./src/main/model/core-agent/chat-history-tools.ts). ### Execution limits and recovery Session locks and concurrency limits bound parallel work. Tool-round budgets, progress checkpoints, repeated-call checks and phase-aware idle watchdogs help contain runs that stall or repeat work. Named agent tasks can be tracked and cancelled individually; an admitted or queued task is not treated as a completed result. See [actor budgets](./src/main/features/group_chat/actor-budgets.ts), the [agent runtime](./src/core-agent/src/agent/runner.ts) and the [desktop model adapter](./src/main/model/core-agent/client.ts). ### Learning from activity Background reviews examine new agent activity when the app is idle, subject to cooldowns and execution limits. A review may update an agent's self-assessment (`COMPETENCE.md`), reusable methods (`LEARNING_STRATEGIES.md`) or learned skills. Reviews depend on new activity rather than task count, and can conclude that there is nothing worth saving. See the [reflection scheduler](./src/main/features/reflection-orchestrator.ts) and [review prompt](./src/core-agent/src/evolution/metacognition.ts). --- ## FAQ **What is Orkas?** Orkas is an open-source (MIT), local-first multi-agent desktop app. Its Commander turns your goal into to-dos and coordinates 16 built-in specialist agents — plus Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes-Agent — to deliver finished files. Not a single chatbot, not a code framework, not a hosted SaaS. **Do I need an API key?** No. The packaged app comes with 500 credits for the built-in Orkas model. After that, buy credits, choose a paid plan or add your own provider keys; provider charges are separate. **Is Orkas a local LLM?** No. Orkas runs on your machine and calls the models you choose — the built-in Orkas model, your own API keys, or a local model endpoint. It orchestrates agents and tools; it is not itself a model. **Can Orkas answer questions from my documents, with citations?** Yes. Add PDFs and documents to your local Library; Orkas can search them and answer with citations to source passages, so you can open the original and check. The index is built on your machine. **Can I use local models like Ollama or LM Studio?** Yes. Open **Account settings → Models → Chat → Add model → Custom**, select **OpenAI-compatible** or **Anthropic-compatible**, and enter the base URL, exact model ID, and API key. Choose the saved model from the task's model control. **Where are my API keys and data stored?** On your disk by default. Your own provider keys are encrypted locally and excluded from cloud sync. With your own keys, model calls go straight from your machine to the provider; the built-in Orkas model uses Orkas's managed service. Optional cloud sync and shared projects in the packaged app store the selected data on Orkas servers. [Security and data handling →](https://orkas.ai/security/?source=gh-orkas) **Does Orkas work offline?** The source build can run fully offline against a local model endpoint. The packaged app needs to sign in, and cloud models need a network connection. **Does it keep working when my computer is off?** No — Orkas runs on your computer, so Auto-advance and automations need the computer awake and Orkas running. From v1.9, each automation catches up its most recent missed run within 12 hours when the computer wakes or Orkas starts. **Can I build and publish apps?** Yes. Local apps that run inside Orkas are free. Publishing a web app to a public link needs a paid plan (Lite 5, Pro 8, Max 15 apps), and published web apps don't include every capability available inside Orkas. **Do I need an Orkas account?** The packaged desktop app asks you to sign in when you first launch it. The source build in this repository has no account layer at all — it boots straight into the app. **Can Orkas drive Claude Code and other CLI agents?** Yes. Orkas can drive five external CLI agents as local subprocesses — the coding agents Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode, plus the personal agents OpenClaw and Hermes-Agent — and onboard open-source projects like HyperFrames, all directed from the same chat. **How is Orkas different from Claude Code / Codex / CrewAI / LangChain?** Claude Code and Codex are coding agents — Orkas runs both as members of its team, so you don't have to choose between them; CrewAI and LangChain are code-first frameworks. Orkas is an open-source desktop app where a Commander coordinates a team of specialist agents and your CLI agents, with any model provider, and keeps data and keys local. See the [full comparisons](https://orkas.ai/compare/?source=gh-orkas). **Which platforms does Orkas support?** macOS 12+ (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Windows 10+ have packaged installers. glibc 2.34+ Linux x64/arm64 runs from source today, with no installer yet. Local speech transcription is supported on Linux through the pinned whisper.cpp runtime prepared on first launch. Alpine and other musl-based distributions are not supported. The source bootstrap needs Node 22.12+; Python 3 and a C/C++ build toolchain are needed only when a native npm package has no compatible prebuilt binary and must be rebuilt locally. **Is Orkas free and open source?** Yes — the app is MIT licensed and free to use. The packaged app includes 500 credits for the built-in Orkas model; paid plans from $11.99/month add monthly credits, cloud sync, more shared projects and app publishing. With your own keys, model usage is billed by your provider; Orkas does not add a markup. [Pricing →](https://orkas.ai/pricing/?source=gh-orkas) --- ## License [MIT](./LICENSE)

快速开始 想直接用安装包？见上方 [下载](#下载)。以下是从源码运行的方式 —— 也是目前在 Linux 上运行 Orkas 的方式： **环境要求**：Node 22.12+ · macOS / Windows 10+ / 基于 glibc 2.34+ 的 Linux x64 或 arm64。建议保留 Python 3 与 C/C++ 构建工具链，用于少数原生模块需要源码编译的兜底场景。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/Orkas-AI/Orkas.git cd Orkas ./run.sh # macOS / Linux run.cmd # Windows ``` Linux 源码运行需要 glibc 2.34+，不支持 Alpine 及其他基于 musl 的发行版。本地语音转写会在首次源码启动时下载并校验目标架构对应的 whisper.cpp 运行时及多语言模型。 `run.sh` / `run.cmd` 会在首次启动时安装 lockfile 固定的 npm 依赖，并准备固定版本的 Python、uv、Node、嵌入模型（约 95 MB）、OfficeCLI、FFmpeg、whisper.cpp 与多语言语音模型。Linux 启动还会在 Electron ABI 下验证平台原生模块及 Whisper 运行时后再打开应用。OCR 与 Skill 专属 Python 包会在首次使用对应功能时安装到隔离的本地环境。首次启动会在 `~/.orkas/`（macOS / Linux）或 `<最小的非系统盘>:\.orkas\`（Windows）下创建工作区。随后进入 **设置 → AI 服务商** 配置 API key 或 OAuth。 遇到原生依赖错误时，请使用 Node.js 24 LTS（最低 22.12.0），在此源码目录执行 `npm run native:repair`。它会恢复可选依赖、修复 Electron 对应的 SQLite，并验证 SQL、 sqlite-vec，并准备随包 Node、在独立进程中验证 sharp 后才报告成功。只检查、不安装可运行 `npm run native:check`。 具体检查内容见[原生依赖校验脚本](./scripts/verify-native-dependencies.cjs)。 --- ## 工作原理 ### 任务分工 指挥官亲自处理通用工作，通过三种工具委派专业任务： - **`dispatch_to`** 调用具名智能体，取得结果后继续工作；既可等待结果，也可异步运行，在任务结束后通知指挥官。 - **`hand_off_to`** 将剩余工作交给具名智能体，并结束指挥官当前回合，由智能体直接回复；如果还有更大的任务待完成，也可设置后续步骤，让指挥官之后恢复工作。 - **`run_worker`** 执行匿名、隔离的子任务，将结果私下回传；它不接收对话历史或具名智能体的技能。 具名智能体任务和匿名 worker 分别受并发控制。参见[派发实现](./src/main/features/group_chat/bus.ts)与[执行锁](./src/main/util/locks.ts)。 ### 上下文管理 运行时根据所选模型可用的输入容量分配上下文，计入提示、工具和持续保留的运行状态。已完成对话使用有界的近期历史窗口；较长的当前任务通过检查点压缩早期过程消息，保留近期工作。文件读取、文件变更与命令执行也有结构化记录，可在上下文压缩后保留。 参见[上下文预算](./src/core-agent/src/agent/context-budget.ts)、[会话历史与检查点](./src/core-agent/src/agent/session.ts)和[工作区记录](./src/core-agent/src/agent/workspace-state.ts)。 ### 记忆与资料库 持久记忆分别保存用户偏好、项目事实和各智能体可复用的知识；它们与资料库的文档索引、已保存的对话历史是不同的数据来源。 资料库将文档提取成段落，建立本地 SQLite 向量索引，嵌入模型在你的电脑上运行。智能体通过 `library` 工具列出文件、搜索相关段落和读取来源内容，范围包括全局资料库与当前项目资料库；较早的对话则通过 `chat_history` 单独检索。 参见[分层记忆](./src/main/features/memory.ts)、[文档提取](./src/main/util/file_to_chunks.ts)、[资料库工具](./src/main/model/core-agent/kb-tools.ts)和[对话检索](./src/main/model/core-agent/chat-history-tools.ts)。 ### 执行保护与恢复 会话锁和并发限制控制同时运行的工作量。工具轮数预算、进度检查点、重复调用检查和分阶段的空闲监测，共同约束停滞或重复执行的任务。具名智能体任务可以单独跟踪和取消；任务已接收或已排队，不会被当作已经完成。 参见[角色预算](./src/main/features/group_chat/actor-budgets.ts)、[智能体运行时](./src/core-agent/src/agent/runner.ts)和[桌面模型适配层](./src/main/model/core-agent/client.ts)。 ### 从工作中积累经验 后台复盘在应用空闲时检查智能体的新活动，并受冷却间隔和执行限制控制。复盘可更新智能体的自我评估（`COMPETENCE.md`）、可复用方法（`LEARNING_STRATEGIES.md`）或学习到的技能，也可以判断没有值得保存的新内容。复盘依据新活动安排，而非按完成任务的次数触发。 参见[复盘调度](./src/main/features/reflection-orchestrator.ts)与[复盘提示](./src/core-agent/src/evolution/metacognition.ts)。 --- ## 常见问题（FAQ） **Orkas 是什么？** Orkas 是开源（MIT）、本地优先的多智能体桌面应用。指挥官将目标拆成待办，协调 16 个内置专业智能体，以及 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、OpenClaw 和 Hermes-Agent，交付成品文件。 **需要 API Key 吗？** 不需要。安装版赠送 500 积分，可直接使用内置 Orkas 模型。用完后可购买积分、选择付费会员，或添加自己的模型服务商 Key；自有服务商的费用单独计算。 **Orkas 是本地大模型吗？** 不是。Orkas 在你的电脑上运行，调用你选择的内置 Orkas 模型、自有 API Key 或本地模型端点。它负责协调智能体与工具，本身不是模型。 **能基于我的文档回答问题，并标注出处吗？** 可以。把 PDF 和文档加入本地资料库，Orkas 可搜索这些文件，并在回答中引用来源段落，方便打开原文核对。索引在本机建立。 **能使用 Ollama、LM Studio 等本地模型吗？** 可以。打开 **账号设置 → 模型 → 对话 → 添加模型 → 自定义**，选择 **OpenAI 兼容** 或 **Anthropic 兼容**，填写基础地址、准确的模型 ID 和 API Key，然后在任务的模型控件中选择已保存的模型。 **API Key 和数据存在哪里？** 默认保存在本机。你自己的服务商 Key 在本地加密保存，并排除在云同步之外。使用自己的 Key 时，模型调用从本机直连服务商；内置 Orkas 模型使用 Orkas 托管服务。安装版的可选云同步和共享项目会将所选数据保存在 Orkas 服务器上。[安全与数据处理 →](https://orkas.ai/security/?source=gh-orkas) **Orkas 能完全离线使用吗？** 源码版配合本地模型端点可以完全离线运行。安装版需要登录，云端模型调用需要联网。 **电脑关机后还会继续工作吗？** 不会。Auto-advance 和定时自动化需要电脑保持唤醒，且 Orkas 正在运行。从 1.9 起，电脑唤醒或应用启动后，每个自动化会补跑 12 小时内最近一次错过的任务。 **能做应用和发布应用吗？** 可以。在 Orkas 内运行的本地应用免费。将网页应用发布为公开链接需要付费会员，Lite、Pro、Max 分别可发布 5、8、15 个；公开网页应用不包含 Orkas 桌面应用内的全部能力。 **需要 Orkas 账号吗？** 安装版首次启动时需要登录。本仓库的源码版没有账号模块，启动后直接进入应用。 **能驱动 Claude Code 等 CLI 智能体吗？** 可以。Orkas 能将五个外部 CLI 智能体作为本地子进程运行：Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、OpenClaw 和 Hermes-Agent；也可接入 HyperFrames 等开源工具，在同一个对话中协调工作。 **和 Claude Code、Codex、CrewAI、LangChain 有什么不同？** Claude Code 和 Codex 是编程智能体，Orkas 可以把它们都作为团队成员来运行，不必二选一；CrewAI 和 LangChain 是代码优先的框架。Orkas 是开源桌面应用，由指挥官协调专业智能体与 CLI 智能体，可选择不同模型服务商，数据与 Key 默认保存在本地。[查看完整对比](https://orkas.ai/compare/?source=gh-orkas)。 **支持哪些平台？** macOS 12+（Apple Silicon 与 Intel）和 Windows 10+ 提供安装包。glibc 2.34+ Linux x64/arm64 目前通过源码运行，尚无安装包；首次启动会准备固定版本的 whisper.cpp 运行时，支持本地语音转写。不支持 Alpine 等基于 musl 的发行版。源码启动需要 Node 22.12+；只有原生 npm 包缺少兼容的预编译文件、需要本地重建时，才需要 Python 3 和 C/C++ 构建工具链。 **Orkas 免费且开源吗？** 是的，应用采用 MIT 许可证，可免费使用。安装版赠送 500 积分；付费会员每月 $11.99 起，增加月度积分、云同步、更多共享项目和网页应用发布能力。使用自己的 Key 时，模型用量由服务商计费，Orkas 不加价。[价格 →](https://orkas.ai/pricing/?source=gh-orkas) --- ##
